entry.title: Porchlamp snapshot 2026-10-27: 11,000 open-source projects measured
entry.summary: We followed 1,442,863 pull requests from 227,260 outside contributors to 11,000 GitHub projects, from 25 April to 22 October 2026. 3,028 ranked, 5,092 gated and 2,880 unrated.

entry.title: Stars don't review pull requests: the state of open-source black holes
entry.summary: More than 1 in 8. In Porchlamp's 2026-10-27 snapshot, 567 of 4,169 active open-source projects (13.6%) left most outside pull requests with no human reply, review, merge or close within 14 days or since. More stars, more silence. The share rises with stars: 11% of projects with 1,000 to 10,000 stars, 17% at 10,000 to 50,000, and 17% at 50,000 or more.
